title: [4.7.dev4] Tree.get_drop_section_at_position() does not return the correct value
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in 4.7.dev4 and later
- Not reproducible in 4.7.dev3 and earlier

### System information

Godot v4.7.dev4.mono - Windows 10 (build 19045) - Multi-window, 2 monitors - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4070 Ti (NVIDIA; 32.0.15.9174) - 13th Gen Intel(R) Core(TM) i7-13700K (24 threads) - 63.74 GiB memory - WASAPI (48000 Hz, Stereo/mono)

### Issue description

Related: #112993

Prior to v4.7.dev4, Tree.get_drop_section_at_position() would always return the most specific drop flag for the position (i.e. -1 for the top of an item, 0 for the middle of the item, 1 for the bottom of the item, and -100 for empty space.) After v4.7.dev4, the correct value will not always be returned.

Case: No drop mode flags are set
- v4.7.dev3: -1, 0, 1, and -100 are returned as expected
- v4.7.dev4: Only 0 and -100 are returned: 0 when on an item, and -100 when in empty space

Case: Both drop mode flags are set, Hide Root is set to true
- v4.7.dev3: -1, 0, 1, and -100 are returned as expected
- v4.7.dev4: 0, 1, 2, and -100 are returned as expected, but -1 will not be returned for any direct children of the root

It seems like the second case is the result of intended behavior for a non-hidden root, as no item would be able to be placed above it, and is erroneously being applied to first-level children when the root is hidden. This does not make sense for first-level children, as they may be allowed to be re-ordered to before the first child.

The larger issue, however, is that after these changes, it is now impossible to get the correct drop section in situations where dropping an item there would not be allowed. There are a number of different situations where you would want to be able to access the theoretical drop section regardless of whether it would be valid, such as changing the text of a warning tooltip or writing custom logic to determine if the specific item being dropped is valid in that section.

It is unclear if this is an intended change, but if it is, it is a compatibility-breaking change, which #112993 is not labeled as (assuming that PR introduced the issue).

### Steps to reproduce

- Create a scene with a Tree node
- Add a script to the Tree node that creates several TreeItems
- Print the result of get_drop_section_at_position() at the current mouse position within _gui_input()

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[tree_dropflags_mrp.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/27145647/tree_dropflags_mrp.zip)
